partners.mechanism_chain: ATP8B1 (HGNC:27424) —DISRUPTS→ Bile acid transport (REACT:R-HSA-2402406); Bile acid transport (REACT:R-HSA-2402406) —LEADS_TO→ Intrahepatic cholestasis (HP:0001362); ATP1A3 (HGNC:730) —DISRUPTS→ Neuronal ion homeostasis (GO:0007272); Neuronal ion homeostasis (GO:0007272) —LEADS_TO→ Cerebellar ataxia (HP:0001251); Neuronal ion homeostasis (GO:0007272) —LEADS_TO→ Sensorineural hearing impairment (HP:0000405); Neuronal ion homeostasis (GO:0007272) —LEADS_TO→ Optic atrophy (HP:0000647). Loss-of-function mutations in ATP8B1 disrupt bile acid transport, leading to intrahepatic cholestasis. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in ATP1A3 disrupt neuronal ion homeostasis, contributing to cerebellar ataxia, sensorineural hearing loss, and optic atrophy. While the specific pathways are distinct, both arise from disruptions in fundamental cellular transport and homeostasis mechanisms.

falsification.text: Demonstration that mutations in ATP8B1 do not impair bile acid transport or that mutations in ATP1A3 do not affect neuronal ion gradients would falsify this hypothesis.
